concerns.text: Task T023-MCMC explicitly instructs to 'Run for exactly 5000 steps... Do NOT stop early based on Gelman-Rubin,' which directly contradicts FR-003's requirement to run 'OR until the Gelman-Rubin statistic < 1.01, whichever requires more steps.' This semantic weakening of the convergence logic violates the spec's accuracy requirement.

Task T030-LOO states 'If runs < 3, log a SKIPPED status... and do NOT fallback to bootstrap,' which violates FR-001 and FR-005's mandatory fallback to bootstrap resampling when fewer than 3 runs are available. This drops the acceptance criterion for robustness analysis in low-data scenarios.

Task T027-GEN instructs to construct a 'block-diagonal matrix (bandwidth = 20)' for subsampled data, introducing an unvalidated correlation structure (off-diagonals) not present in source data and not authorized by FR-002 or Constitution Principle VI. This creates an inconsistent data representation strategy compared to the zero-off-diagonal matrix in T015-Z-COV-CONSTRUCT.

Task T013-ORCH-ROUTE triggers T013-BOOTSTRAP if run count < 3, but T030-LOO (Phase 5) explicitly forbids fallback to bootstrap for cross-validation. This creates a logical conflict where data preparation generates bootstrap resamples that the robustness analysis phase is instructed to ignore, leaving the user with no valid robustness metric if runs < 3.

Task T023-MCMC includes runtime enforcement to trigger T027-GEN (subsampling) if projected time > 5.5 hours, but T027-GEN is a Phase 3 task with dependencies on T014. This creates a potential execution deadlock where the MCMC task needs subsampled data before the data generation task (triggered by MCMC logic) can run, violating FR-006's automatic sampling requirement.
